title: Domestic proportion before ideal new comfort

captions.physics: Maintaining familiar comfort at freedom’s expense
captions.energy: Comparing the available with ideal futures
captions.emotions: Feeling proportion between needs and capacity

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its measure when both choose enough now instead of retaining binding comfort merely because its replacement does not yet match an ideal future picture.
text: The Devil in the physical position of Muladhara describes actions maintaining familiar comfort even at the cost of free choice. The Star in energy complicates them through an ideal future replacing available support. Temperance in emotions feels suitable measure. The present can remain excessively heavy. Both see too much work but permit reduction only after faultless new arrangements appear. A manageable option exists yet seems insufficiently worthy to alter habit and genuinely release present shared domestic life from some of its demands.

For example, extensive bedding supplies remain stored. Quantity tires both, but reduction awaits an ideal bedroom renovation after which everything supposedly becomes proportionate by itself. **Present measure can be chosen before a dream is finally realised.** Actual use can be named and enough retained. Support returns to both instead of a new picture indefinitely maintaining earlier weight merely so a future change may one day look entirely complete, beautiful and final.

The difficulty is considering limited reduction abandonment of something better. Maintenance continues while proportion stays future. Distinguishing direction from scale offers more dependable support: a small step can suit the dream. Home supports both through manageable present choices without every attempt to ease life awaiting a day when all shared life finally matches an ideal picture.
